name: orbital
description: Orbital: a marketplace of intent-shaped Claude Code plugins. Skills are arranged in orbits around a shared core — formal-reasoning pipeline, architectural analysis, parallel orchestration, and developer utilities — each plugin answering one question about what invoking it does for you.

plugins.name: shifting
plugins.description: Formal logic reasoning pipeline — seven staged primitives (closed-world KB construction, proposition decomposition, target-world model construction, Lean 4 proof verification, property instantiation as TDD tests, proof-grounded specification realization, terminal adherence scoring) plus the unstaged `explain` closer and the unstaged `disprove-proposition` debate move. Skill descriptions are tailored toward dispatch from the `trajectory:pipeline` orchestrator (which supports modular partial slices); direct invocation is reserved for explicit single-stage requests. The Lean toolchain bootstrap skills (`setup-lean-mathlib`, `setup-lean-project`) moved to the `scaffolding` plugin in 5.0.0 so a single `scaffolding:setup` flow owns marketplace-wide provisioning.

plugins.name: scaffolding
plugins.description: Adopter onboarding, environment provisioning, and C4 architectural modeling. Owns the marketplace-wide `setup` skill (interviews the adopter, creates thoughts/, appends .gitignore, writes .claude/orbital-setup.json marker), the Lean toolchain bootstrap skills (`setup-lean-mathlib`, `setup-lean-project` — relocated from `shifting` in 4.0.0), and the C4-model phase skills (find/define/condense + orchestrator). A SessionStart hook announces the marker state so downstream skills don't re-probe the filesystem.

plugins.name: trajectory
plugins.description: End-to-end orchestration of the seven-stage shifting pipeline. Runs a single ticket through some contiguous slice of close-world → decompose-proposition → model-obligations → prove-invariants → instantiate-properties → realize-specification → measure-entailment, then always finishes with the `explain` closer (unstaged narrator that runs regardless of scope). Defaults to the full sequence when no scope is given; supports partial runs (entry mid-pipeline, early exit, or both) when the user names entry/exit stages or when `thoughts/` already holds upstream artifacts from a prior run. Renamed from `orchestrate`; the parallel multi-enhancement skill has been retired in favor of the single-ticket flow. Defers Lean toolchain setup to `scaffolding:setup-lean-mathlib` / `scaffolding:setup-lean-project` (relocated from shifting in 5.0.0).

plugins.name: telemetry
plugins.description: Standalone developer utilities: logical commit generation, presentation creation, and bounded recurring loops.
